currentParagraphText: “I see great minds think alike,” Jake said, as he already knew where Artemis was going with this.

finalResult.currentParagraphText: “I see great minds think alike,” Jake said, as he already knew where Artemis was going with this.
finalResult.nextParagraphText: Seeing as Artemis was so much stronger than Jake, it was hard for her to show him anything he could learn from. That’s why they needed a way to level the playing field and not make sheer power the limiter... and Jake had just the thing for it, something Artemis already knew all about.
finalResult.previousParagraphText: “That being the case, I believe the best approach would be for you to experience archery at a higher level directly,” Artemis said as she smiled. “Plus, it should be at least a little nostalgic for you, while to me, it will be a chance to experience something I’ve only seen recordings of myself doing.”
